en_title: Zach Cregger Says He Feels Like He's 'Running for Office' Trying to Get Skeptical Resident Evil Fans 'Not to Call Me a LARPer'
cn_title: 《生化危机》导演：我像在竞选公职
subtitle: 先看电影
opus_summary: 《生化危机》导演回应粉丝质疑，称自己像在进行「道歉巡演」。他希望观众先看电影再评价，影片预计北美首周末票房达3500万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，有望创系列最高纪录。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has said he feels like he’s been on an “apology tour” while navigating skepticism from some fans about his movie adaptation of Capcom’s horror franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》导演Zach Cregger表示，在应对部分粉丝对自己改编卡普空恐怖系列电影的质疑时，他感觉自己像是在进行一场「道歉巡演」。

paragraphs.en: Cregger, director of hugely popular horror movies Barbarian and Weapons, has faced scrutiny from Resident Evil fans ever since it was confirmed that his adaptation wouldn’t feature any characters from the video games, or tell any of the stories already told in the video games. Instead, Cregger has charted his own path, telling a horror story set in the world of Resident Evil that references some of the video games' tropes .
paragraphs.cn: Cregger曾执导广受欢迎的恐怖电影《Barbarian》和《Weapons》。自从确认他的改编电影不会采用游戏中的任何角色，也不会讲述游戏已经讲过的任何故事后，《生化危机》粉丝便一直在审视他的做法。Cregger选择走自己的路，在《生化危机》的世界中讲述一个恐怖故事，并参考了游戏中的部分惯用元素。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with The Playlist , Cregger outlined how it has felt to promote Resident Evil amid this backlash.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受The Playlist采访时，Cregger谈到了自己在这些反对声音中宣传《生化危机》时的感受。

paragraphs.en: “I feel like I’ve been on somewhat of an apology tour,” he said. “I feel like I’m running for office, trying to get these people not to call me a LARPer.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我觉得自己可能有点像在进行一场‘道歉巡演’。我感觉自己像是在竞选公职，努力让这些人别叫我LARPer。」

paragraphs.en: His comments here echo those he made to IGN’s Tom Jorgensen recently when talking about the reception to Resident Evil. “I think I was naive,” he said. “I thought fans of these games, like me, would be thrilled that somebody was coming along and turning Resident Evil into a survival horror movie. I was like, ‘That’s great.’ I did not really appreciate the sentiment that, ‘We’ve been waiting forever for Leon’s story.’ And I appreciate that, and I’m sorry that’s not the story I’m bringing. I get it, I understand the frustration. I understand it so well because I haven’t seen the earlier [Resident Evil] movies, because they don't look like the Resident Evil that I love, so how could I be frustrated with fans who have that same attitude?”
paragraphs.cn: 他最近接受IGN的Tom Jorgensen采访、谈及《生化危机》获得的反响时，也曾表达过类似看法。他说：「我觉得自己可能有点像在进行一场‘道歉巡演’。我以为，像我一样喜欢这些游戏的粉丝，会因为有人把《生化危机》拍成生存恐怖电影而感到兴奋。我当时还想：‘太棒了。’我确实没有真正理解‘我们等里昂的故事等了太久’这种心情。我理解这一点，也很抱歉自己带来的不是那个故事。我明白，我理解这种失望。我之所以如此理解，是因为我没看过之前的《生化危机》电影——因为那些电影看起来不像我所热爱的《生化危机》——所以，我怎么能对抱有同样态度的粉丝感到不满呢？」

paragraphs.en: With Resident Evil now just a week away, Cregger is philosophical about fan attitude to the film. “Now, I’m just like, ‘You know what? See the movie.’” he told The Playlist. “If you still feel the same way after you’ve seen it, then whatever you think is fair. You’re going to decide if I’m an actual Resident Evil fan or a fake. What can I say? I think the movie is going to speak for itself.”
paragraphs.cn: 如今距离《生化危机》上映只剩一周，Cregger表示自己已经看开了粉丝对这部电影的态度。他对The Playlist说：「现在，我只想说：‘你知道吗？先去看看电影。’如果看完电影后你仍然这么想，那无论你怎么想，都是合理的。你们会自行判断我究竟是不是真正的《生化危机》粉丝，还是个冒牌货。我还能说什么？我觉得电影自然会说明一切。」

paragraphs.en: Again, those comments echo those he gave to IGN. “My only hope is that they’ll see the movie regardless of their skepticism or their disappointment that I’m not telling some of the stories that the games tell so well, and they will feel seen when they do watch the movie, and they will recognize all of the love for the games that are in this movie, because it is there,” he said.
paragraphs.cn: 这些话也呼应了他此前接受IGN采访时的说法。他说：「我唯一的希望是，无论他们是对这部电影抱有怀疑，还是因为我没有讲述那些游戏讲得很精彩的故事而感到失望，他们都会去看这部电影；看完后，他们会感到自己的想法得到了理解，也会看出这部电影中对游戏的热爱，因为这种热爱确实存在。」

paragraphs.en: “This is not me just telling a story and slapping Resident Evil on it so I can get a budget. This is me telling a Resident Evil story. I understand the resistance, I do, because I have it myself. It is coming from a true place of love.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我不是随便讲个故事，再把《生化危机》的名字贴上去，好拿到一笔预算。这是我在讲述一个《生化危机》故事。我理解这种抵触，真的，因为我自己也有这种抵触。这种抵触源自真正的热爱。」

paragraphs.en: In the same interview with The Playlist, Cregger said he’d love to tell more stories in the Resident Evil universe , but he’s also said he’s done with franchise films after Resident Evil .
paragraphs.cn: 在同一次The Playlist采访中，Cregger表示，他很愿意继续讲述《生化危机》宇宙中的更多故事，但他也曾表示，拍完《生化危机》后，自己就不再拍系列电影了。

paragraphs.en: Will he get the chance to make another Resident Evil? According to Deadline , Resident Evil is tracking to make $35 million at the domestic box office during its opening weekend, although it could go higher. $35 million would be the biggest domestic opening ever in the Resident Evil franchise, beating the $26.6 million Resident Evil: Afterlife opened with in 2010.
paragraphs.cn: 他还有机会再拍一部《生化危机》吗？据Deadline报道，《生化危机》预计首周末北美票房将达到3500万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，但最终可能更高。如果达到这一数字，该成绩将成为《生化危机》系列有史以来最高的北美开画成绩，超过2010年《生化危机4：战神再生》首周末取得的2660万美元(约合人民币2亿元)。
